name: Six-Vendor CAD, MBD/PMI, Surfacing & Multi-Provider AI Audit Release
summary: Pro3DWorks v3.2.4 resolves findings from a six-vendor expert audit spanning SolidWorks, Siemens NX, CATIA, Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic: native Anthropic/Gemini/o3-gpt-5 protocol adapters, cached & reasoning token cost accuracy, chiral BOM/revision comparison, full SolidWorks/JT/AP242 PMI/CNC-DFM/RFQ/Release Review accuracy, CATIA surface-model splitting & non-manifold region merging, and project state persistence.

highlights.title: SolidWorks Assemblies, Sections, Drawings & Chiral BOM
highlights.text: Guards v4 .SLDASM configuration stamps and child visibility inheritance, extracts Zonal section cut entities and cap loops accurately, prevents smooth pin-in-bore contact false positives, transforms drawing vertex normals correctly, preserves curved radial measurements, and adds rotation-invariant chiral PCA identity keys.

highlights.title: Siemens NX JT Inspector, AP242 PMI, CNC DFM & Mirrored Revisions
highlights.text: Adds standalone .jt header/segment inspection, per-datum [M] modifiers, COMMON_DATUM, P, and UZ AP242 PMI parsing, full active-unit CNC DFM CSV/text formatting and persisted disposition notes, and chiral mirrored revision matching.

highlights.title: CATIA Surfacing, Release Review, RFQ & PDF-to-DXF Integrity
highlights.text: Supports multi-shell SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL STEP splitting, all *SHAPE_REPRESENTATION inch unit detection, quote/comment-safe Part-21 references, #010101 PDF RGB stroke preservation, order-independent non-manifold face regions, persistent Release Review manual BOM pairing, and active-unit RFQ lot mass.

highlights.title: OpenAI, Gemini & Anthropic Protocol, Cost & Prompt Hardening
highlights.text: Adds native Anthropic /v1/messages & Gemini /v1beta/openai routing, reasoning/temperature rules across gpt-5/o3/minimal/xhigh, key redaction and nonce-delimited prompt sanitization, cached/reasoning token cost accounting, strict-schema fallbacks, confirm gating for material edits, and bounded transient retries.

notes: All CAD geometry, RFQ intake, CNC DFM, DXF preflight, Release Review reconciliation, PDF-to-DXF/DWG conversions, and GPU renders run locally on your workstation — zero customer model uploads.
Managed offline mode ('no_external_network') provides technical egress controls and is not a claim of organizational ISO/IEC 27001 certification or TISAX assessment.
OpenCascade / occt-import-js (LGPL-2.1) is shipped in separate relinkable desktop files alongside LICENSE.md; see docs/SBOM.cdx.json.
